text: This report recommends that the name "Jean Lumb Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane east of Huron Street, extending south of Dundas Street West. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Jean Lumb Lane" for an existing public lane east of Huron Street, extending south of Dundas Street West.
